sections.heading: Gather in the Garden is just like coming home
sections.html:
by Sunflower Creative Arts | Jan 7, 2015 | Community, Happening at Sunflower

You know that feeling you get on Thanksgiving? When you’ve been putting together a savory meal, you’re dressed and the kids are all ready? You head over excited to share your tasty dish with some of your favorite loved ones.

Read More

The next Gather in the Garden is

Saturday, March 12, 2016

in the Sunflower Learning Garden.

4:30 – 6:30 pm • 227 N Dixie Blvd, Delray Beach, FL 33444

Please check our page for the next Gather in the Garden date and to RSVP.

Eventbrite

Bring the kids, friends, neighbors… all are invited!

• Bring a dish to share. All food must be NUT-FREE

• Help us protect the environment by bringing your own reusable dishes and cutlery.

• If you like, bring a beach blanket or towel for your family to sit on.

• Music welcome. If you or your kids play an instrument – bring it!

• Open to the whole Sunflower Community and their friends. Come PLAY with us!
